summary: Dokbua Gym is a Muay Thai gym in Ubon Ratchathani offering training with optional accommodation on monthly packages.

facts.label: Fan room plus training, per month
facts.quote: fan room + training from 17000 baht / Month

facts.label: Aircon room plus training, per month
facts.quote: aircon room + training from 22000 baht / Month

facts.label: Training times
facts.quote: Morning training 8-10 AM Afternoon training 4-6 PM.

facts.label: Accommodation
facts.value: Standard fan room with shared bathroom, or large air-conditioned room with private bathroom
facts.quote: Acommodation in a large aircondition room with private bathroom

facts.label: Trainers
facts.value: Three trainers: Kru Dang, Kru Noom and Kru Kie
facts.quote: Kru Dang is the senior trainer and Kru Noom and Kru Kie are younger trainers
